activity.notes: Joseph Broussard dit Beausoleil was a principal leader of Acadian resistance to British rule before, during and after the Deportation. Parks Canada specifically identifies his leadership of the resistance in 1755–1762. ATLAS therefore models the Acadian resistance community rather than assigning him to the British colonial polity that he opposed.

sources.citation_text: Parks Canada identifies Broussard as a leader of the Acadian resistance and gives the core resistance-leadership interval as 1755–1762.
